carryInDispositions.disposition: Observed in S5/S5c: re-provision of an active seat needs an explicit confirmation naming the new identity; the new playerId differs; the ghost stays a member and the host refuses the new identity while it holds a seat (campaign-tactical-seats-full in the server log).

Autocomplete attributes verified (N6: current-password on create, primary and join; new-password on the new seat password; unnamed and empty after submit). The browser password-manager prompt cannot be observed by Playwright and stays a human item for Step 8.

Restart observed in S7: seats and public ids unchanged and the InMemoryPlayerStore dev-only warning seen. matchRecovered=no comes from the spec any-close heuristic; app-restart-stdout.log shows the GM and P1 sockets accepted and bound to campaign A and only the P2 original seat-2 bearer refused (expired at 19:18:44Z). Inconclusive, not a product defect. Identities survive a restart (keys, seat rows in SQLite); player profiles held by InMemoryPlayerStore are lost. The decision is still open: closure rules no repair or registers a profile-persistence follow-up (P2J depends on it). STEP2-RC-RERUN-1 records recovery per profile.

KNOWN ISSUE, disclosed and not fixed in v2.2.0 (owner decision 2): after the re-provisioned guest joins a second campaign, the same profile opened on the first campaign shows the HOST badge and the host review surface (S5b observation 3). N4 is asserted before S5b and passed. Security half (F1 investigation 2026-10-24): from that view the dashboard whole-record save is accepted by PUT /api/campaigns/[id] and an anonymous DELETE of a live-host campaign answers 204; the campaign socket is not affected. CAMPAIGN-LIVE-WRITE-1 (release-blocking) owns the fix and it is not in this build. This run checks host surfaces in the UI (N4) and distinct verified principals (S1); it attempts no host action from a guest profile.

Recorded in the proof doc known gaps and the prep findings: refused join leaves a stored bearer and binding in that tab (F2); the join dialog never shows the host refusal reason (F3); a closed socket is not reconnected (F4); the forget control and BINDING_REQUIRED text are unreachable in a bare second tab (F5); the update check contacts GitHub at start (F6); agent shells export ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE (F7). None is fixed here (no src/ scope).

Campaign B never held the old seat-2 identity: S5b shows a re-provisioned identity admitted where a tactical seat is free, not the admission longer sequence (old identity joins B, re-provision, new identity takes the remaining seat while the ghost stays). The OWNER-RULING should accept the narrowing or move the full sequence to STEP2-RC-RERUN-1.

F4: the app does not reconnect a closed campaign socket; players reload after a drop or restart. F5: the BINDING_REQUIRED text does not render in a bare second tab (S2c records, does not assert). Both are in the proof doc Known gaps; Root decides whether F4 needs an owner before the human session.
